name: Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya
bio: A Hanbali jurist born in Damascus in 691 AH (1292 CE), he took the name Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya from his father’s work as superintendent of the Jawziyya school. He studied with Ibn Taymiyya and was imprisoned with him in the citadel of Damascus until his teacher’s death. His writings range from law and the inner life of the believer to theology in verse. He died in Damascus in 751 AH (1350 CE).
